title: Dialogue: Phrasal Verbs in Conversation 1 (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij ponizsze dialogi (1.1-1.6), wybierajac brakujace wyrazenie A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: Why wasn't Tomek at training yesterday?
Y: He's ______ down with flu.

X: Have you booked that dentist's appointment yet?
Y: No, I keep ______ it off.

X: Ania has exactly the same sense of humour as her dad.
Y: I know, she really ______ after him.

X: Why did you stop halfway through the recipe?
Y: We ______ out of eggs.

X: Do you think he'll be punished for copying the homework?
Y: Knowing him, he'll ______ away with it.

X: The school trip has been cancelled again.
Y: Really? Who ______ it off this time?
